title: Nvidia joins Lambda's $480M Series D

sources.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce a $480M Series D co-led by Andra Capital and SGW with participation from new investors Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, and others.

explain: Nvidia invested an undisclosed amount in Lambda's $480 million funding round. Lambda rents out Nvidia GPUs, so Nvidia is backing one of its own customers.
